description: React component file defining various DID status badges, count badges, identity badge, and composite status component for a web UI.

methods.name: DIDStatusBadge
methods.description: React component displaying a badge with DID status, icon, and styling based on status.

methods.name: DIDCountBadge
methods.description: React component showing a badge with count of reasoners or skills.

methods.name: DIDIdentityBadge
methods.description: React component displaying a DID string with optional copy-to-clipboard button.

methods.name: CompositeDIDStatus
methods.description: React component combining status badge, count badges, and DID identity into a composite display.
